Peak Performance Physical Therapy is a patient-centered physical therapy clinic located at 789 Pearl Street in Boulder, Colorado. Founded and led by Dr. Sarah Mitchell, DPT, who brings 15 years of specialized experience in treating athletes and active adults. The clinic specializes in sports rehabilitation, post-surgical recovery, and chronic pain management, serving Boulder's active community with evidence-based treatments. Services include manual therapy, dry needling, movement analysis, sports-specific rehabilitation, and injury prevention programs. Dr. Mitchell and her team focus on addressing root causes of pain and dysfunction, not just symptoms, using comprehensive movement assessments and personalized treatment plans. The clinic is open Monday through Friday 7am-6pm and Saturday 8am-12pm. Contact information: phone (303) 555-7890, email hello@peakpt.nephew.app. Peak Performance PT is ideal for athletes recovering from injuries, individuals needing post-surgical rehabilitation, people managing chronic pain conditions, and anyone looking to optimize their movement and prevent future injuries. The clinic's patient-centered approach emphasizes education and empowerment, helping clients understand their conditions and develop strategies for long-term success.
